summary: Iter 21 — Task delegation offer/accept, scheduled tasks, direct assign, calendar aggregation + presentation. BACKEND 9/9 PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_oryntix_iter21.py, ~80s): (A) long delegation 'proposal pelatihan karyawan 2027…' streams final SSE with tool='task_offer' + pending_task.title='Proposal Pelatihan Karyawan 2027' and content contains both 'bahas satu per satu' and 'terima beres'; GET /api/tasks has no new task yet. Short q 'Apa ibu kota Australia?' returns a plain final (no tool). (B) POST /conversations/{cid}/tasks/accept {mode:'delegate'} returns tool='task_assigned' + task_id; GET /tasks/{tid} shows type='assigned', source='chat', persona_name set; task polls to status='completed' with non-empty final_output and credits_used>0; last assistant msg in conversation has tool='task_done' + task_id; /task-notifications includes it; POST /task-notifications/ack then GET returns no row for that task; re-POST /accept → 400 'Tidak ada tawaran…'. (C) New conv + delegation with 'Kerjakan lusa jam 10 pagi.' → offer; then plain /send 'terima beres saja' final event has tool='task_assigned'+task_id and GET /tasks/{tid}.status='scheduled' with scheduled_at > now (UTC). Discuss branch: new conv + delegation → POST /accept {mode:'discuss'} returns assistant message proposing steps, tool != 'task_assigned', and no new task created. (D) POST /conversations/{cid}/tasks {title,brief,scheduled_at:null} returns {task_id,status,when,assistant} and task completes to 'completed'; invalid cid → 404. (E) POST /events normalizes start_at to UTC; GET /calendar aggregates kinds event+task+(reminder/meeting if present), sorted by 'at'; DELETE /events/{id} 200 then 404; bad dates → 400. Member budi@aivora.ai sees demo's event in his /calendar (mine=false) and gets 404 on DELETE. FRONTEND (desktop 1920x1080): login via /, home shows nav-calendar + persona cards. /calendar: cal-month 'Oktober 2026', cal-prev/cal-next change month, cal-today returns, cal-day-YYYY-MM-DD selects day, cal-day-panel shows date, cal-add-event opens event-form (title/time/notes), event-save adds event — toast 'Event ditambahkan' + chip in grid + cal-item-event in day panel; event-delete-{id} removes it. Scheduled task chips appear on their day (saw 'Proposal Pr…' blue task items on 5-Oct). Chat flow: new chat with persona Rio → sent long delegation → assistant message with task-offer-buttons (discuss + delegate) rendered; click 'Terima beres' → new message 'Beres! Tugas Proposal Pelatihan Karyawan 2027 sudah masuk ke Ruang Kerja…' with 'Lihat di Ruang Kerja' link, offer buttons removed; topbar-bell shows unread badge (TaskNotifier). /workspace lists the new task with status 'Completed'. Live 'sudah selesai ✅' message not seen in the open chat panel during 90s polling — appears to require a chat reload / navigation because private chats don't receive server-pushed messages via WS; the TaskNotifier bell + Workspace list both confirm completion correctly, so this is a UX gap, not a functional failure.

integration_issues.issue: assistant message 'Tugas … sudah selesai ✅' posted by execute_assigned_task is persisted but is not pushed live to an already-open /chat/{cid} window — Chat only ingests messages via its own /send SSE stream. Current compensating UI is the topbar-bell TaskNotifier (works) + the Ruang Kerja list refresh. If the UX contract requires the chat panel to show it live, add polling in Chat.jsx for the active conversation or broadcast via WS also for private chats.

action_items: Consider auto-updating the open /chat/{cid} view when a background task posts a 'task_done' assistant message (either poll /messages after a task_assigned, or broadcast on the existing WS). Current TaskNotifier + Ruang Kerja updates are correct, but the chat message only shows on next conversation open.
critical_code_review_comments: assignments.py execute_assigned_task is fired via asyncio.create_task without any retry/backoff — if the LLM throws, the task is marked 'failed' with error[:300] and the user only sees it in Ruang Kerja (no chat notification posted on failure). Consider posting a failure message in the originating conversation too (currently only task_done is posted).

assignments.create_assigned_task adds the task to db.tasks and fires asyncio.create_task(execute_assigned_task). If uvicorn restarts (hot reload) between create and complete, the task stays stuck in 'queued' until tasks_tick re-queues it after 10 min — tasks_tick already handles that stale case, good.

accept_pending clears conv.pending_task BEFORE creating the task; if LLM assign flow raises after that, the user cannot retry the offer. Low risk because create_assigned_task is just a DB insert, but worth noting.

/api/calendar aggregates via several Mongo queries without a compound index; fine for current scale but add indexes on (workspace_id, scheduled_at), (workspace_id, completed_at), (workspace_id, start_at) if volume grows.

assign_task endpoint resolves pid using `x.persona_id if x.persona_id in (conv.get('persona_ids') or []) else conv.get('persona_id') …` — relies on `persona_id` fallback; for group/meeting convs persona_id is None, picks first of persona_ids which is OK.
offer_text / plan_task triggers only when TASK_RE matches AND len(text) >= 25; verified short Q 'Apa ibu kota Australia?' correctly bypasses the offer. Good.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_oryntix_iter21.py -o addopts='' -v` (~80s). Frontend selectors confirmed: auth-email-input/auth-password-input/auth-submit-btn; new-chat-btn + new-chat-modal + pick-{persona_id} + start-conv-btn; chat-input / chat-send-btn; task-offer-buttons / task-offer-discuss / task-offer-delegate; nav-calendar; cal-month / cal-prev / cal-next / cal-today / cal-day-YYYY-MM-DD / cal-day-panel / cal-add-event / event-form / event-title / event-time / event-notes / event-save / cal-day-items / cal-item-{kind} / event-delete-{id}; topbar-bell for TaskNotifier. Server clock is 2026-10-02 UTC. LLM for executed tasks takes 10-40s; use ≥90s polling. If the backend reloads mid-test (hot reload after file edit) the running asyncio task is lost — simply re-run the specific test, tasks_tick will not re-queue it before 10 min so prefer re-run over waiting.
rca of the issue: Only observation: open /chat/{cid} does not render the 'Tugas … sudah selesai ✅' message in real time because Chat.jsx consumes new messages via its own /send SSE stream and reloads /messages only on cid change. Background tasks created from the SAME chat insert a new assistant message in db.messages but do not emit through the client's current stream. Workaround options: (1) poll /conversations/{cid}/messages every N seconds while a task_assigned is pending in that conv; (2) ride on the existing WS broadcast used for meetings; (3) rely on topbar-bell TaskNotifier (current, works). This is a UX gap not a functional bug — all backend contracts (notifications ack, task_done message in DB, /tasks completed) verified green.
